purpose: Define every clickable room prop as a workstation, report surface, mission target, or approval surface.
runtime_rule: Clicking a prop opens a dashboard/report popup only. Chat belongs to Agent characters; props never own a chat composer.
backend_rule: GET /api/props/:id/report must merge prop metadata, strictly routed missions and reports, agent events, memory cards, relevant meeting records, sanitized bridge status, and contract-owned capability status.
capability_rule: A prop receives only capabilities whose linkedPropIds includes that prop; disabled or unimplemented adapters must remain visibly fail-closed.
